news.words: Watson won't return to Sunday's game against the Bengals after suffering an Achilles injury... it is feared that Watson suffered a torn Achilles, and if that's the case, the QB would face an extended absence.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Daniel Oyefusi, ESPN)
news.words: Browns head coach Kevin Stefanski noted after Sunday's 21-14 loss to the Bengals that Watson is believed to have suffered a season-ending Achilles injury but will undergo testing to confirm the severity of the issue.

The Browns announced that starting QB Deshaun Watson will undergo surgery to repair his Achilles injury, which will end his 2024 season. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) confirmed on Monday morning that Watson sustained a ruptured right Achilles tendon.

An MRI Monday revealed Watson indeed suffered a tear... The severity of the injury means Watson is done for the year... He could come back for Week 1 of the 2025 season if the surgery on the area is successful.
